title: Align declared review-bridge policy with enforced task PR checks

fail_closed_contract.rule: When github_review_bridge_required is false, Pantheon canonical review gate must be absent from branch_workflow.task_pr.required_status_checks; when true, it must be present. Missing, malformed, duplicated, or contradictory policy raises ValueError fail-closed.

drift_detection.behavior: Compares review bridge flags between repo and live configs. Rejects and fails closed on contradictory/malformed policy on either side even if equal or with --fix.

live_provisioning.behavior: Carries review-bridge and task-PR status checks into rendered config and validates using common.validate_review_bridge_policy() before emission.

auto_integrator.merge_authority: TaskStore exact-head reviewer approval remains mandatory.

behavior.valid_false_mode: External canonical-gate failure is diagnostic only and does not block merge; recorded in ignored_diagnostic and auditable in candidate logs.
behavior.declared_checks: Presence and successful terminal results are strictly enforced for every declared context before diagnostic filtering. Failure blocks and pending waits without REST merge or integration receipt.
behavior.contradictory_config: Contradictory or malformed policy fails closed at candidate evaluation, execute authority resolution, and final revalidation. Final revalidation raises contradictory-review-bridge-policy, which is repair-producing in the shared contract. Execute publishes a durable request after releasing authority locks; supervisor materializes one exact-delivery-bound repair task through TaskStore without changing source approval, merging, or recording an integration receipt.
behavior.valid_true_mode: Canonical review gate failure blocks merge unless verified proof tags exist.

separation_of_authorities.statement: This delivery modifies committed source configuration, validation logic, drift detection, provisioning guards, and auto-integrator tests. It does not mutate the live supervisor runtime config or execute runtime promotion. Live runtime promotion remains a separate governed operation via existing promotion tooling. No GitHub branch-protection PATCH, credential rotation, or external identity changes were performed.

test_results.summary: Accurately detects drift in branch_workflow.task_pr.required_status_checks and reports live contradictory review bridge policy failure
Read-only drift probe reports required_status_checks source/live mismatch and contradictory live review-bridge policy; no fix requested. Also reports five missing worker_slots entries.

test_results.command: .venv-pantheon/bin/python3 -m pytest -q .orchestrator/test_common.py scripts/test_provision_live_supervisor_config.py scripts/test_check_config_drift.py scripts/git/test_auto_integrator.py .orchestrator/test_supervisor.py -k 'not test_supervisor or AutoIntegratorUnblockAuthorityTests' --tb=short

verification.base_composition: Latest dev adds only the separately validated CI smoke timeout task (#5739): branch-ci.yml, its gate-selection tests, and its evidence. No overlap with the review-bridge implementation; task source tested at validated_source_commit is unchanged by composition.

delivery.runtime_promotion: not performed; live policy drift remains until governed promotion
